title: styrax officinalis var. fulvescens
intro: Styrax officinalis var. fulvescens, commonly known as American golden styrax or golden styrax, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and other nervous system disorders due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its antispasmodic, anti-anxiety, and sedative properties, which help to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Styrax officinalis var. fulvescens include a combination of sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and resinous materials that contribute to its therapeutic actions.
